first_action: Observe original native item/started for webSearch or mcpToolCall, close new admissions for that exact task, use native turn/interrupt, drain existing responses and keep terminal events. No MCP synthetic source body is delivered in this mode.
no_retrieval: Absence is conclusive only after natural completion and complete native/provider evidence.
full_turn: Record Runtime completed/failed/interrupted independently from answer/source review. Synthetic answers never grant real full-task success.
sample_stop: The meter acknowledgement is the admission cutoff; already admitted response data remains observable. It is not a guarantee of stopping all provider work at the first native event.
diagnostics: Serialized journal sequence, closed reason code and surface, native task/thread/turn binding, counts and primary denial reference. Never raw exceptions, prompts or credentials.
prior_paid_grant: Consumed by v1; cannot be used by v2.
preservation: v1 code, cases, source lock, real recording, score and consumed authorization remain byte-identical.
